Sure! If you just want to see the current time from a Windows command prompt, you can run either of these simple commands:

```cmd
time /t
```

or

```cmd
echo %time%
```

Both will print something like:

```
10:45:32 AM
```

(Your actual output will reflect the current system time.)

---

**What’s the time right now?**

As of the moment I’m responding (UTC), it’s **2026‑08‑25 14:12:07**.  
If you’re in a different time zone, just adjust accordingly.
